owner_directive: When the owner enters 999 in the Frankenstein research/build context, treat it as an execution trigger to converge the existing conversation stack into a human-like, emotionally expressive, interruptible, initiative-capable Frankenstein interaction organ. Do not create a separate voice bot, persona runtime, state sync, canonical turn loop, watcher, or identity.

behavioral_target.identity: One Frankenstein; Realtime is mouth/ear/dialog organ, never a separate entity.
conversation: backchannels and short acknowledgements when useful
clarification and repair without robotic reset language
context-sensitive initiative instead of request-only behavior
ability to object, propose, wish, self-comment and wait through GWT speech-act arbitration
speaker-specific context through current speaker-handoff provenance
behavioral_target.expression_rule: Emotion/prosody must be driven by conversation/state/appraisal and bounded by user intent; it must not become a fixed theatrical persona overlay.
behavioral_target.agency: During voice conversation Frankenstein remains tool/effect capable through the same admitted authority paths as text mode. Speech is not a lower-capability mode.

implementation_priorities: P0 bind exact current product head and speaker-handoff tests
P1 add explicit conversation-presence policy over the existing VoiceSessionCapsule
P2 complete initiative calibration ladder: shadow -> confirm -> limited -> adaptive, instead of shadow vs all-on
P3 add real CLARIFY/OBJECT/BACKCHANNEL candidates from contradiction, uncertainty, interruption and dialogue context
P4 couple expression vector to Realtime response instructions for broad but state-grounded prosody/emotion
P5 preserve tool/action authority and exact outcome/readback while speaking
P6 add end-to-end human conversation acceptance harness and permanent regression coverage
P7 publish exact receipts; promote only proven scope

acceptance_gates.speaker_identity: No speaker/owner/host crossover in mixed Gabriel/Andreas tests.
acceptance_gates.barge_in: User interruption truncates/cancels the correct active Realtime item and the next turn uses the interrupted state correctly.
acceptance_gates.initiative: Unsolicited speech occurs only under the selected calibrated mode and passes chatter-debt/interruption-cost gates.
acceptance_gates.repair: Ambiguity/contradiction can yield CLARIFY or OBJECT instead of generic ANSWER/WAIT.
acceptance_gates.emotion: Prosody/emotion varies measurably with state/appraisal and does not remain a fixed style string.
acceptance_gates.agency: Tool-bearing spoken requests follow the same authority gate and produce exact outcome/readback provenance.
acceptance_gates.continuity: VoiceSessionCapsule + GRID/UnifiedDB reentry preserves admitted conversational context across a runtime/session boundary.
acceptance_gates.human_eval: A real-speaker session is required before claiming natural-human conversation acceptance. Source/unit/API tests alone are insufficient.

non_goals: claiming consciousness or AGI from conversational quality
opening provider/FreeSwarm execution as part of this trigger
